hypothesised_pattern: Rows with |x4| above 1 are class_2, and rows below that are class_1 or class_0 by whether the signs of x2 and x5 match or differ.
functional_form_guess: if |x4| > 1 then class_2, else if sign(x2) == sign(x5) then class_1, else class_0
rationale: Rows 3, 4 and 8 are class_2 with |x4| of 1.79, 1.02 and 1.37. The other seven rows have |x4| of at most 0.69, and the rule holds for all of them, including rows with very small x2 or x5 values, which points to sign rather than size.
